scan_linter_check.description:
Flags the deprecated JSON APIs: new JSON().encode()/decode() (directly or through a variable holding new JSON()), .evalJSON(), Object.toJSON() and new JSONParser(). Plain .toJSON() methods (standard JavaScript, for example on Date) are not reported.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Deprecated JSON Methods", which also flagged every .toJSON().
scan_linter_check.name: JS-003: Deprecated JSON API
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Use the native JSON.stringify() and JSON.parse() instead of new JSON().encode/decode, evalJSON(), Object.toJSON() or JSONParser.
scan_linter_check.short_description: new JSON().encode/decode, evalJSON(), Object.toJSON() or JSONParser is used.
